statements.text: Removing a graph, removing all graphs and starting an adjacency rebuild are refused when the lock is not granted in 5 seconds. Nothing is written.
statements.notes: Live: a second process holds ^IVG.AdjW exclusively (Native API lock, shown in ^$LOCK). The refusal is implemented: erase_graph, erase_all and sync (BuildKG) each raised the writer-lock error and the seeded rows and ^KG out entries are all still there; after the lock is released the same erase_graph succeeds (control). 'Nothing is written' does not hold: the journal keeps net changes the rollback does not undo (^IVG.AdjNoLock(g), ^KG("gen",g,src), ^KG("__version"); BuildKG only the version), and the erase refusal comes after 5 s per deleted edge row plus 5 s (15.07 s, 20.07 s): F-C0415 (S4).
live_cases: erase_graph('rx04g') while ^IVG.AdjW is held -> refused after 5 s
erase_all() while ^IVG.AdjW is held -> refused after 5 s
sync() (BuildKG) while ^IVG.AdjW is held -> refused after 5 s

statements.text: A rebuild of the interned snapshot waits for any other one. It is refused after 900 seconds.
statements.notes: Live: a second process holds ^IVG.NKGBuild exclusively; engine.rebuild_nkg() (BuildNKG) waited and raised 'another ^NKG build held ^IVG.NKGBuild for 900 seconds' (elapsed time in the case record). EnsureNKG (:410-413) shares the lock and the wait; not probed separately.
